paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
model_annotation: The figure presents two vertically stacked line plots illustrating the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, with the x-axis representing the number of training steps (ranging from 0 to 500) and the y-axis showing training rewards (scaled from 0.0 to 0.4). In the top panel, titled "Easy Training Set," both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal line) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red line) begin near a reward of 0.0 and exhibit upward trends over 500 steps. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy method reaches a final reward of approximately 0.4, while Llama-On-Policy-Easy stabilizes at around 0.35. The red line consistently remains above the teal line, maintaining a performance gap of about 0.10 throughout training. In the bottom panel, "Hard Training Set," Llama-LUFFY-Hard (red line) shows steady improvement, increasing from near 0.0 to a final reward of approximately 0.2 by step 500. In contrast, Llama-On-Policy-Hard (teal line) initially rises to about 0.05 around step 100 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150, resulting in minimal final performance. The two methods only diverge significantly after step 200 in this setting, highlighting a more pronounced performance gap on the Easy set compared to the Hard set.
